task: R4A-b persistence and variance of the per-series gain
evidence_class: MECHANISM / NEGATIVE-capable; not a capability claim
question: R4A showed the condition is neither in the series' visible past nor in its own future.  Is the per-series gain a stable property at all -- a series-layer property, a cohort x origin property, or mostly noise?

provenance.feature_card_function: evaluation.main_protocol_p4.audit_cross_fitted_targeting.series_features, reused; only the twelve numeric observables are kept, no mechanism and no ORACLE quantity

alias_check.handling: skipped from every table; its readings would be ANCESTOR's to the last digit

row_construction.repeated_measures: the same twenty uids recur at every position of their cohort, so rows are not independent; no significance is claimed
row_construction.why_dropped: a degenerate uid is outside the executed scope, so its reading is the untreated one by construction

definitions.cross_face_pair: the same (position, uid) read at origin and at origin+48
definitions.position_share_one_way: SS_between(position) / SS_total over all rows of the face
definitions.uid_share_weighted: inside each cohort, the uid main effect of an additive (uid + position) decomposition, SS_uid / SS_total; averaged over the four cohorts weighted by rows
definitions.residual_share_weighted: the same decomposition's residual SS(g - mean_uid - mean_position + mean) / SS_total, row-weighted
definitions.share_null_expectation: (levels - 1) / (rows - 1), the expected between-group share under exchangeable noise; a diagnostic only, it changes no frozen threshold
definitions.unit_level_condition: the unit's own mean gain used as a score for its own rows; in-sample ceiling, NOT deployable, not comparable to a LODO number
definitions.best_visible_series_level: pooled AUC over the twelve numeric observables, oriented as max(auc, 1-auc); pooled, not LODO

verdict_rules.SERIES_LEVEL_CONDITION: uid share >= 0.30 and cross-face Spearman median >= 0.50
verdict_rules.MOSTLY_NOISE: cross-face Spearman median < 0.30 and uid share < 0.30 and position share < 0.50
verdict_rules.note: the cross-face Spearman median is a program-level quantity by construction -- one pairing serves both faces -- so the two faces of a program share it
